COURSE TITLE    CIVIL PROCEDURE CODE & LIMITATION ACT
COURSE CODE     10FL1604
COURSE CREDITS  4

Objective:
 1  To study in detail the procedure for redressal of civil rights.
 2  To study the nature and significance of pleadings and practical aspects relating to suits of
      civil nature.
 3  To understand the execution proceeding of suits of civil nature.
 4  To study the applicability and relevance of law of limitation as applicable to civil
     proceedings.


Course Outcomes: After completion of this course, student will be able to:
 1  Understand the detailed procedure for redressal of civil rights, including the process of
      filing a civil suit, evidence taking, trial proceedings, and execution of decrees.
 2  Identify the parties involved in civil suits, understand the rules and requirements related to
     plaint and written statement, and distinguish between different legal remedies such as
     appeals, review, reference, and revision.
 3  Apply knowledge of civil procedure to analyze legal scenarios and determine appropriate
     actions and legal remedies.
 4  Analyze complex civil cases to identify key legal issues, evaluate evidence, and formulate
     effective legal strategies.
 5  Comprehensive understanding of procedural rules, case law, and legal principles to develop
    comprehensive legal strategies for representing clients in civil litigation.

COURSE TITLE    PROPERTY LAW
COURSE CODE     10FL1605
COURSE CREDITS  4

Objective:
 1  To empower the students of law with theoretical as well as practical knowledge of property
     matters and its transfer vis a vis its importance in family disputes.
 2  To be familiar with the provisions of the Transfer of Property Act and how there have been
     judicial precedents in this regard.


Course Outcomes: After completion of this course, student will be able to:
 1  Define the various kinds of properties.
 2  Describe the principles of transfer of property applicable to both movable and immovable
     properties.
 3  Identify the principles applicable to the Transfer of Immovable Property
 4  Relate the provisions of Sale and Mortgage.
 5  Relate the provisions of Charge and lease.
 6  Interpret provisions of Gift and Actionable Claim.
